content: We need to determine number of C=O groups in the compound. No SMILES given. We need to infer from NMR or IR? We can get IR spectra to see carbonyl stretch. Use ir_spectra tool. That will give peaks, we can count carbonyl peaks (~1700 cm-1). Could also use carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons (~190-210 ppm). Probably cheaper to use IR. Use ir_spectra.
